governance_note: Define graph nodes, node boundary, and units of analysis.
Document what relationships produce graph edges.
State whether the graph is directed, undirected, weighted, bipartite, temporal, multilayer, or simplified.
Define whether weights represent distance, capacity, cost, frequency, probability, exposure, or similarity.
Review walks, paths, cycles, components, reachability, and shortest paths.
Choose centrality measures only when they match the systems question.
Align traversal, shortest path, flow, clustering, and ranking algorithms with graph semantics.
Review source data, missing nodes, missing edges, false edges, stale weights, and measurement bias.
